title: Insperity Unveils Its AI Capabilities for the Future of HR Highlighting New Insperity HR360 AI Agent
summary: Explore Insperity's latest news, awards, and resources
body_markdown:
*New AI conversational intelligence to be combined with Insperity HR service and expertise*


HOUSTON–([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )–As organizations navigate a workplace increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence (AI),[Insperity, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com%2F&esheet=54622839&newsitemid=20261015752898&lan=en-US&anchor=Insperity%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=f2bd62a9c27652fc032eb92f1d780f4c) (NYSE: NSP), a leading provider of human resources and business performance solutions for small to midsize businesses, announced its approach to help clients analyze and transform their workforce in the AI era.


Insperity’s AI strategy spans the enterprise, supporting employees, client-facing service teams and external customers through Insperity’s growing AI capabilities connecting AI to extensive HR expertise and proprietary knowledge.


“HR decisions require judgment, expertise and a deep understanding of people,” said Paul Sarvadi, chairman and chief executive officer of Insperity. “Our strategy combines the power of AI with the experience of our HR professionals to strengthen the speed and consistency of the client experience, while advancing access to actionable insights through conversational intelligence.”


**Meet the Insperity HR360 AI Agent**


Insperity continues to invest in AI-powered capabilities that help businesses navigate workforce challenges, improve productivity and make smarter decisions. At the heart of that vision is the[HR360 AI Agent](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com%2Four-products%2Fhr360%2F%23ai-agent&esheet=54622839&newsitemid=20261015752898&lan=en-US&anchor=HR360+AI+Agent&index=2&md5=2cd47210b0b15bc9b468592551b4a0f1) , an exciting new capability being rolled out within Insperity’s existing best-in-class Insperity HR360 solution. This AI Agent is designed to help clients get faster answers to HR questions, more easily access workforce insights and navigate HR responsibilities with greater confidence.


Access to HR experts and personalized service will remain a hallmark of the Insperity service delivery model, helping clients resolve HR challenges and implement people strategies to transform their business.


**Faster Answers**


The new AI Agent handles everyday HR administration questions and guides users directly to the correct location within the Insperity HR360 solution to complete a task. Whether an administrator needs to add a new manager, update employee information or understand required training, the HR360 AI Agent can provide direction and users can ask follow-up questions and receive responses that build on previous interactions, creating a more intuitive and efficient way to navigate HR responsibilities.


The AI Agent is also designed to help managers lead important people-related moments by providing information, guidance and resources ranging from performance review preparation to coaching development.


This helps leaders spend less time searching for answers and more time focusing on developing employees and growing their business.


**Personalized Guidance Grounded in Company Policies**


Many HR questions depend on company-specific policies rather than generic information. The HR360 AI Agent is designed to help users access guidance informed by their company policies and resources maintained with Insperity. For example, when an administrator asks about the vacation accrual process for an employee hired mid-year, the system can draw from the organization’s specific policy.


**Conversational Workforce Intelligence**


Future capabilities under development for the HR360 AI Agent include providing workforce insights, as clients will be able to ask questions and receive insights in an intuitive, conversational format. The planned functionality would allow users to enter simple commands such as “show me headcount by location” or “how have our employee engagement metrics trended over time,” and receive reports, graphic visualizations and contextual insights, helping leaders access information more quickly and make better-informed workforce decisions.


**AI That Strengthens Human Partnerships**


The HR360 AI Agent provides quick access to valuable information and insights, while maintaining a direct path to Insperity specialists when situations require expertise, judgment or consultation. To help companies be successful in the era of AI transformation, Insperity is combining the convenience of AI with the confidence of human support to create a new service delivery model to support small and mid-sized businesses and their employees in the years ahead.


**About Insperity**


Since 1986, Insperity’s mission has been to help businesses succeed so communities prosper. Offering a suite of the most comprehensive, scalable HR solutions available in the marketplace, Insperity is defined by an unrivaled breadth and depth of services and level of care. Through an optimal blend of premium HR service and technology, Insperity delivers the administrative relief, reduced liabilities and better benefit solutions that businesses need to drive performance and growth. With 2025 revenues of $6.8 billion and sales and service operations throughout the U.S., Insperity is currently making a difference in thousands of businesses and communities nationwide. For more information, visit[https://www.insperity.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com%2F&esheet=54622839&newsitemid=20261015752898&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.insperity.com&index=3&md5=8ce5623afe307c6c26fb7b1807b36a39) .
